objectives.title: Shell from an overflow
objectives.prompt: Exploit a Vulnserver command to get a shell on the machine (Vulnserver runs as SYSTEM) and read C:\ctf\flag.txt. The vagrant RDP login is for debugging only.
hints: Connect to port 9999 and ask the server which commands it understands.
Fuzz the commands one at a time with a debugger attached to vulnserver.exe and watch which one crashes and what registers you control.
essfunc.dll ships next to the binary and is not rebased: a classic place to look for a useful instruction.

steps.title: Talk to the server
steps.prompt: Which command makes Vulnserver list the commands it accepts?

steps.title: Know the target
steps.prompt: Which memory protection is turned off on this machine, as on the Windows versions the exercises were written for? (acronym)

steps.title: The classic bug
steps.prompt: The TRUN command is the usual first exercise. What class of vulnerability does it have? (memory region + bug class)

steps.title: A different overwrite
steps.prompt: Overflowing GMON corrupts something other than the saved return address first. Which Windows structure-based technique does it call for? (acronym)
